primary_metric: average precision mean over clean, 10%, 30%, 50% MCAR
prior_art_status: regression-based feature imputation is established (MICE/FCS; sklearn IterativeImputer); no exact anchor-threshold variant located, novelty unestablished
limitations: Uniform MCAR fixture has no stable-anchor/volatile-feature structure: at 10% every column is an anchor and there are no volatile features; at 30% and 50% all columns are volatile and there are no anchors.

No Ridge model is fit and no test entry is reconstructed in any stress condition. Thus measured AP difference is native-NaN HistGradientBoosting versus median-imputed HistGradientBoosting, not anchor-conditioned reconstruction.
Three synthetic seeds only; exploratory, not significance evidence or external validation.
